_meanings:
An emphatic particle used to lay stress on the preceding
 word and translatable by ‘verily’, ‘indeed’, ‘certainly’, <ab>&c.</ab>; but it
 is often used expletively without any particular signification, especially
 in Vedic literature; {#tasya ha SataM jAyA baBUvuH#}; {#tasya ha parvatanAradO#}
 {#gfha UzatuH#} <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Ait. Br.</ls>; {#dvayA ha prAjApatyA devAScAsurASca#} <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 1</ls>.
 It is sometimes used as a vocative particle and rarely of
 disdain or laughter.
